questions.title: Food Club - Part 1

metadata.scenario: What did you eat for breakfast?

questions.stem: Respond to the messages in the group.

questions.prompt: Nowadays, many people order pizza instead of cooking by themselves when busy. What about you? When you are busy, what do you usually eat?
questions.sample_answer: Fast food has become very trendy due to its convenience. It saves time and effort after a long day of work. Pizza is also budget-friendly compared to homemade meals. When I’m busy, I often order pizza too.

questions.prompt: Is it essential for children to participate in cooking courses at school?
questions.sample_answer: Yes, it’s very important. Learning to cook makes children more independent and able to care for themselves. It also helps strengthen family bonds when they prepare meals together, making it a meaningful and practical life skill.

questions.prompt: Should a tax be imposed on unhealthy food?
